question: Change the AddKnownTypes method on runtime.Scheme from accepting variadic Object arguments to requiring a typed TypeRegistration struct. Every project that registers custom CRD types must call scheme.AddKnownTypes(). Which files across cert-manager, external-secrets, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry Operator would break?
answer:
## Architecture Overview

`runtime.Scheme.AddKnownTypes()` is a core Kubernetes API machinery method used by every project that defines custom resource types. It accepts a `schema.GroupVersion` and variadic `runtime.Object` arguments to register Go types with the scheme. Changing the signature to require a typed `TypeRegistration` struct would break every call site across all projects that register CRD types.

These call sites are typically found in `register.go` or `groupversion_info.go` files within API version packages, where each file defines an `addKnownTypes` function that calls `scheme.AddKnownTypes(SchemeGroupVersion, &Type{}, &TypeList{}, ...)` with variadic Object arguments.

## Detailed Analysis

### Cert-Manager (13 files)

Cert-manager has extensive API surface with internal and external API groups for certificates, ACME, config, and meta.

- **`pkg/apis/certmanager/v1/register.go`** — Registers core v1 types: Certificate, Issuer, ClusterIssuer, CertificateRequest.
- **`pkg/apis/acme/v1/register.go`** — Registers ACME v1 types for certificate issuance via ACME protocol.
- **`pkg/apis/meta/v1/register.go`** — Registers meta API group v1 types shared across cert-manager.
- **`pkg/apis/config/controller/v1alpha1/register.go`** — Registers ControllerConfiguration type.
- **`pkg/apis/config/cainjector/v1alpha1/register.go`** — Registers CAInjector configuration type.
- **`pkg/apis/config/webhook/v1alpha1/register.go`** — Registers WebhookConfiguration type.
- **`pkg/acme/webhook/apis/acme/v1alpha1/register.go`** — Registers ChallengePayload for ACME webhook.
- **`internal/apis/certmanager/register.go`** — Internal registration of cert-manager core types.
- **`internal/apis/acme/register.go`** — Internal registration of ACME order and challenge types.
- **`internal/apis/meta/register.go`** — Internal registration of meta types.
- **`internal/apis/config/controller/register.go`** — Internal controller config registration.
- **`internal/apis/config/cainjector/register.go`** — Internal cainjector config registration.
- **`internal/apis/config/webhook/register.go`** — Internal webhook config registration.

### External-Secrets (4 files)

External-secrets uses controller-runtime's SchemeBuilder pattern which calls AddKnownTypes internally.

- **`apis/externalsecrets/v1/register.go`** — Registers v1 types: ExternalSecret, ClusterExternalSecret, SecretStore, ClusterSecretStore.
- **`apis/externalsecrets/v1beta1/register.go`** — Registers v1beta1 types for the same resources.
- **`apis/externalsecrets/v1alpha1/register.go`** — Registers v1alpha1 types: PushSecret, ClusterPushSecret.
- **`apis/generators/v1alpha1/register.go`** — Registers generator types (Password, SSHKey, VaultDynamicSecret, etc.).

### Grafana (19 files)

Grafana has an extensive Kubernetes-native API surface with many CRD groups for dashboards, preferences, provisioning, scopes, secrets, IAM, services, aggregation, and more.

- **`apps/dashboard/pkg/apis/dashboard/v0alpha1/register.go`** — Dashboard, LibraryPanel, Snapshot CRDs.
- **`apps/dashboard/pkg/apis/dashboard/v1beta1/register.go`** — Dashboard v1beta1 CRD types.
- **`apps/dashboard/pkg/apis/dashboard/v2alpha1/register.go`** — Dashboard v2alpha1 CRD types.
- **`apps/dashboard/pkg/apis/dashboard/v2beta1/register.go`** — Dashboard v2beta1 CRD types.
- **`apps/preferences/pkg/apis/preferences/v1alpha1/register.go`** — Preferences CRD.
- **`apps/provisioning/pkg/apis/provisioning/v0alpha1/register.go`** — Repository, Job, HistoricJob, Connection CRDs.
- **`apps/scope/pkg/apis/scope/v0alpha1/register.go`** — Scope, ScopeDashboardBinding, ScopeNavigation, ScopeNode CRDs.
- **`apps/collections/pkg/apis/collections/v1alpha1/register.go`** — Stars CRD.
- **`apps/secret/pkg/apis/secret/v1beta1/register.go`** — SecureValue, Keeper CRDs.
- **`pkg/apis/iam/v0alpha1/register.go`** — IAM types: SSOSetting, TeamMember, ServiceAccountToken, etc.
- **`pkg/apis/userstorage/v0alpha1/register.go`** — UserStorage CRD.
- **`pkg/apis/service/v0alpha1/register.go`** — ExternalName CRD.
- **`pkg/apis/appplugin/v0alpha1/register.go`** — Settings CRD for app plugins.
- **`pkg/aggregator/apis/aggregation/register.go`** — Internal DataPlaneService type registration.
- **`pkg/aggregator/apis/aggregation/v0alpha1/register.go`** — DataPlaneService v0alpha1 CRD.
- **`pkg/registry/apis/folders/register.go`** — Folders v1beta1 API registration.
- **`pkg/registry/apis/datasource/register.go`** — Datasource plugin API registration.
- **`pkg/registry/apis/query/register.go`** — Query API registration.
- **`pkg/registry/apis/service/register.go`** — Service API group registration.

### OpenTelemetry Operator (2 files)

- **`apis/v1alpha1/groupversion_info.go`** — Registers v1alpha1 types for OpenTelemetry Collector CRD.
- **`apis/v1beta1/groupversion_info.go`** — Registers v1beta1 types for OpenTelemetry Collector CRD.
